say:1:1430234501:1.text: If you want to maintain your standing as a noble, you need to be well-informed.
say:1:1430234501:1.source_cn: 想要成为屹立不倒的贵族，信息当然要灵通。
say:1:1430234501:1.male: If you want to maintain your standing as a noble, you need to be well-informed.
say:1:1430234501:1.female: If you want to maintain your standing as a noble, you need to be well-informed.

say:3:1430234502:1.text: This returns to the issue of Prince Ravion preferring commoners over nobles. How do we get close to him?
say:3:1430234502:1.source_cn: 不过沙利叶殿下不是更喜欢平民吗？我们要怎么和他亲近？

say:4:1430234503:1.text: We need to get close to the people around him... like Indris!
say:4:1430234503:1.source_cn: 他不行的话我们就去亲近他身边的人，比如说因度厄！
